model: 2-state hidden Markov model, Student-t returns within each state, monthly Sensex 1997-
use: stress scenario only: shapes ANNUAL shocks (crash years cluster); the return level still comes from the shrunk portfolio statistics

validation.method: rolling one-year-ahead predictive log-likelihood, 21 origins from 2005
validation.verdict: Regime models do NOT beat the iid Student-t at forecasting next year's monthly returns, so the main projection keeps the Student-t process. The regime model is used only as a labelled stress scenario for multi-year crash clustering.

shrinkage_backtest.method: forecast each equity fund's next-3-year CAGR from its trailing CAGR, shrunk toward 11% with weight n/(n+tau); 6-monthly origins 2016-2023
shrinkage_backtest.verdict: tau=10 minimises out-of-sample error; the engine uses tau=10.
